claims.content: To allow the System Administrator to create and modify scheduled operations by configuring System Operation Command Schedules.

goal.raw_text: To allow the System Administrator to create and modify scheduled operations by configuring System Operation Command Schedules.

claims.content: System Administrator
The System Administrator initiates configuration of scheduled operations when they need to create or modify a System Operation Command Schedule.

trigger.raw_text: The System Administrator initiates configuration of scheduled operations when they need to create or modify a System Operation Command Schedule.

claims.content: System Administrator creates or modifies system configuration data, including scheduled operations.

System Administrator defines the System Operation Command Schedule with System Operation Schedule ID, Mode, Start day/time, End day/time, Frequency, System OperationalCommand ID or Device Command Macro ID, or Device Command ID.
System Administrator associates the System Operation Command Schedule item with one Agency and one System Mode.
System Administrator configures the System Operation Command Schedule to reflect items scheduled in advance that repeat at a set period, or items entered into the system for immediate execution.

At step 1, if the System Operation Command Schedule is to reference a System Operational Command, the System Administrator selects System Operational Command ID; the System Operation Command Schedule item references one System Operational Command.
At step 1, if the referenced System Operational Command is a System Operational Command (Super Macro), it is composed of one or more System Operational Command Steps.

At step 1, if the System Operation Command Schedule is to reference a Device Command Macro, the System Administrator selects Device Command Macro ID; the System Operation Command Schedule item references one Device Command Macro.

At step 1, if the System Operation Command Schedule is to reference a Device Command, the System Administrator selects Device Command ID; the System Operation Command Schedule item references one Device Command.

At step 3, if the System Operation Command Schedule is entered into the system for immediate execution, configure it to reflect an item entered into the system for immediate execution rather than an item scheduled in advance that repeats at a set period.
At step 3, if the System Operation Command Schedule is scheduled in advance that repeats at a set period, configure it to reflect an item scheduled in advance that repeats at a set period.
The System Operation Command Schedule item refers to one Agency.
The System Operation Command Schedule item refers to one System Mode.
